title: My Morning
text:
I wake up at seven o'clock every day. I brush my teeth and wash my face. Then I eat breakfast with my family. I like toast and orange juice.

At eight o'clock, I walk to school. My school is near my house. I study English in the afternoon. In the evening, I read a book before bed.

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
bread that has been cooked until it is brown and crisp
the part of the day between noon and evening

paragraph_translations: Me despierto a las siete en punto todos los días. Me cepillo los dientes y me lavo la cara. Luego desayuno con mi familia. Me gustan la tostada y el jugo de naranja.
A las ocho en punto, camino a la escuela. Mi escuela está cerca de mi casa. Estudio inglés por la tarde. Por la noche, leo un libro antes de dormir.
